utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive sounds like a great way to help out neighbors—I'm glad we're doing this.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm usually late to these things, but I'll try to make it on time for once.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's good to hear, Dane! We'd love to have you there bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hana, the repair drive starts at 9. Bring your tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: At 9 sharp? I'll bring my kit, but let me double-check which tools you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the basics: wrench and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah, I've been marking down what folks have been donating—looks like we've got enough wood and nails for at least a few more repairs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's good... wait, how many repairs are we doing? I thought we just needed to fix that one fence.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, Mayor Thompson's porch is sagging, and Mrs. Gable's gate is hanging by a thread—so I figured while we've got the supplies, we might as well tackle a few more things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard we're having a repair drive soon. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh yes, I think it's next Saturday. I hope we have enough tools and volunteers to make it run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great. I'm decent with fixing small appliances, maybe I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not entirely sure myself—I just heard it's some kind of community thing to fix up broken items?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who's organizing it? I don't want to sign up for something that turns into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, did you hear about the repair drive they're starting up on Oak Street this weekend? I heard they're finally fixing that old pothole by the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard! I was actually planning to bring my工具箱 over in case anyone needs a hand or a spare wrench.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's so nice of you, Gus! I bet old Mrs. Henderson will be thrilled—she's been complaining about that pothole for months.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We need all the help we can get!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the repair drive! I heard a bit about it. Do you know exactly where and when we're meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center from 10 AM to 4 PM. Bring your tools and a good attitude!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Let me know if you need a hand with anything—I'm pretty handy with tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You're offering to help? That's nice, but are you sure you know what you're getting into? We're fixing up old appliances, not building a birdhouse.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not just a birdhouse builder! I've fixed my share of toasters and washing machines. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Bo, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any help coordinating the volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's going... I think? Haven't really had time to check the list, but sure, any help is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let me pull up the volunteer list and we can sort out who's doing what together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, a repair drive? I hadn't heard. What day and time exactly? I like to keep my schedule straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's this Saturday at 10 AM down at the community center. I'm bringing my toaster for sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Uli! I was just thinking about that repair drive... did I already sign up for something, or was I supposed to bring tools?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sorry, Oren, I'm not sure about the sign-ups. Maybe check the list at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, the community center! I was there yesterday, but I think I forgot my reading glasses again. Could you remind me what time they close?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think it's a great chance for us to help out around the neighborhood!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I hadn't heard about it yet. What exactly do they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community event where we fix up things like broken fences, leaky faucets, and even help with small electronic repairs. Want to join me? I could use a buddy!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, sorry I'm late to the conversation! What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center—folks are bringing broken stuff from furniture to electronics, and we're fixing it up together. Think you can lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Eli, I heard you're running the repair drive. Need any help sorting the donations?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That'd be wonderful, Rey. I could use a hand, as long as we stick to a system. I've got it all categorized by type.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can follow a system. Just point me to the pile you want sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, are you still planning to help with the repair drive this Saturday? I need to coordinate pickup times for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh yes, definitely! I can take the morning shift from 8 to noon, just let me know where to meet the kids.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Mara! Let's meet at the community center parking lot at 7:45 to go over the list of kids.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I heard you’re organizing that repair drive—great idea! I know a few folks in the gardening club who might want to pitch in tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's perfect! I'm planning to set up the repair drive for this Saturday, so if any of them want to bring their tools, that'd be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, I'll reach out to them today and see what they can bring. What time should we start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard we're organizing a repair drive—got my toolbox ready if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Gus, but have we figured out where we're storing the donated tools? I don't want them piling up in the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good point—my garage has some spare shelves, I can clear them out if we need a temporary storage spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Is the repair drive happening at the old garage on Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that's right! The old garage on Elm Street has plenty of space for all the tools and volunteers. I'm so glad you're interested!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I'll mark that on my map. Are we starting at 9 AM sharp?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of repairs are we talking about for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check what exactly needs fixing first—do you know if it's a mechanical issue or a data problem?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm not sure, but it won't even power on, so maybe mechanical?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Sam! I could use some help sorting the donated tools and materials.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'd be happy to help sort things out. When should I come over?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, I heard something about a repair drive — what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, a repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something. What exactly is that?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought you might know! I overheard someone saying something about a repair drive for the neighborhood. Maybe I got it wrong?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going to use that old drive to fix my router? Are you sure it's safe?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh honey, I've used that old thing on half the gadgets in the neighborhood—never had a problem! Plus, I heard the tech guy down the street swears by 'em.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The tech guy down the street? You mean Mr. Chen who still uses a flip phone? That's who you're trusting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard something about that while I was at the grocery store. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, they're collecting old appliances and broken tools at the community center next Saturday. I'm thinking of bringing in that broken blender I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's good to know—I’ve got an old toaster that’s been sitting in my garage forever. Maybe I’ll bring it by too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes, the repair drive! I was meaning to ask about that... what are we fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a community tool-share event. Bring broken stuff; we'll try to fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, that sounds lovely! I've got an old toaster that's been gathering dust—maybe I'll bring that along.
